q: Which gas relights a glowing splint?
Identify gases W, X and Y.
W hydrogen, X oxygen, Y carbon dioxide.
Gas Z gave negative results in all tests. Suggest what it could be.
E.g. nitrogen (or air, or another unreactive gas).
Marble chips react with acid to make gas Y. Write the word equation.
calcium carbonate + hydrochloric acid → calcium chloride + water + carbon dioxide.
